title: Console login card collapses into the single-sign-on view and offers "Back to single sign-on" when email+password is off and phone sign-in is on with no SSO configured
body:
qa#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s

QA-source: #31486 · identity-auth.auth-method-matrix · observed beside the clauses

Found off-clause by the QA run #31486 (subject `0647dabb`), a neighbour of #29159 (which holds for its own case). Seen once in the browser; the mechanism is confirmed in source.

## Reproduction (`os dev` with `OS_AUTH_PHONE_NUMBER_ENABLED=true`)

1. As admin, `PUT /api/settings/auth {"email_password_enabled":false}` → 200. The auth config then reads emailPassword false, sso false, phoneNumber true, phoneNumberOtp true.
2. Open `/_console/login` anonymously: the card shows only "Use a password instead"; the phone and OTP options are not on first paint.
3. Click it: the form shows "Email or phone number", Password, "Sign in with verification code" and a "Back to single sign-on" button, though no SSO exists.

## Mechanism

`ui/packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx`: `passwordFormCollapsed = ssoEnforced || passwordSignInOff` (line 342), and the `backToSsoText` button renders on `passwordFormCollapsed && showPasswordFallback` (line 788). #29159 gated only the copy (`ssoOnlyCopy`, line 510, which checks `ssoEnforced || ssoEnabled`); the collapse and the back button are not gated on SSO being present.

Owning package: `@object-ui/auth` (`ui/packages/auth`). Full evidence: #31486, slice C3a.
